eyebrow.zh: 连载写作 · 本地故事树

headline.zh:
支线可以重选，
旧稿仍然留下。
headline.en:
Choose another branch.
Keep the earlier draft.

sub.zh: BranchTree 把章节、分支与角色事实保存在本地故事树中，让你尝试另一条支线、保留旧稿，并检查明显的事实矛盾。
sub.en: BranchTree stores chapters, branches and character facts in a local story tree so you can try alternate continuations, retain old drafts and inspect explicit contradictions.

caption.zh: 为故事保留不止一种走向
caption.en: Keep more than one path for your story.

body.zh: 支线提升改变分支标签和结尾，已有章节节点仍保存在树中。
body.en: Promoting a branch changes labels and the active ending while retaining existing chapter nodes.

body.zh: 人物名和固定事实为规则检查器提供可定位的参照。
body.en: Character names and pinned facts give the rule checker concrete references.

body.zh: JSON 保存结构，静态 HTML 展示分支与章节，无需运行模型服务。
body.en: JSON stores the structure and static HTML presents branches and chapters without a model service.

title.zh: 为故事保留不止一种走向
title.en: Keep more than one path for your story.

body.zh: 修改连载的某个转折时，新版本不必覆盖后续所有旧稿。故事树把章节之间的父子关系与每个分支的当前结尾分开保存，作者可以比较不同走向，再决定把哪一条提升为主线。事实锁为检查器提供具体参照，并不保证自动消除叙事矛盾。
body.en: Changing a turning point need not overwrite every later draft. A story tree keeps chapter parent links separate from each branch’s active ending, letting the author compare continuations before promoting one to the main line. Fact locks provide references for the checker; they do not guarantee automatic consistency.

body.zh: 例子建立三章，从 ch1 分出 alternate，并在 ch3 写入“林晚左手没有疤”。检查器对锁定事实“左手有疤”报告一条矛盾。合并后 main 指向 ch3，但 ch1、ch2、ch3 均保留；JSON 重新加载有效，静态 HTML 成功写出。临时文件结束后清理。
body.en: The example creates three chapters, forks alternate from ch1, and says Lin Wan has no scar in ch3. The checker reports one contradiction with the pinned scar fact. After merging, main points to ch3 while ch1, ch2 and ch3 remain. JSON reload validates and static HTML is written; temporary files are removed afterward.

body.zh: tree.py 的 StoryTree 保存 ChapterNode、Branch 和 Lock；add_chapter 用父节点连接正文，并更新 active_tip。state.py 仅记录文本长度和已知人物名称出现情况。consistency.py 检查有限的中文显式否定规则；render_html.py 将树渲染为静态 HTML。模型重写和深层抽取在 llm.py 中仍未实现。
body.en: StoryTree in tree.py owns ChapterNode, Branch and Lock. add_chapter connects text to a parent and advances active_tip. state.py records text length and mentions of known character names. consistency.py checks a limited set of explicit Chinese negation patterns; render_html.py exports static HTML. Model regeneration and deep extraction in llm.py remain unimplemented.

body.zh: BranchTree 把章节、分支与角色事实保存在本地故事树中，让你尝试另一条支线、保留旧稿，并检查明显的事实矛盾。
body.en: BranchTree stores chapters, branches and character facts in a local story tree so you can try alternate continuations, retain old drafts and inspect explicit contradictions.

body.zh: 只实现本地树操作和有限规则检查，模型重写尚未实现。
body.en: Only local tree operations and limited rule checks are implemented; model regeneration is not.

note.zh: v0.1.0 使用三章构造文本完成真实树操作、持久化与 HTML 导出。规则命中不是对整部小说一致性的证明。
note.en: v0.1.0 performs real tree operations, persistence and HTML export on three constructed chapters. A rule hit is not a proof of consistency for a whole novel.

body.zh: 例子建立三章，从 ch1 分出 alternate，并在 ch3 写入“林晚左手没有疤”。检查器对锁定事实“左手有疤”报告一条矛盾。合并后 main 指向 ch3，但 ch1、ch2、ch3 均保留；JSON 重新加载有效，静态 HTML 成功写出。临时文件结束后清理。
body.en: The example creates three chapters, forks alternate from ch1, and says Lin Wan has no scar in ch3. The checker reports one contradiction with the pinned scar fact. After merging, main points to ch3 while ch1, ch2 and ch3 remain. JSON reload validates and static HTML is written; temporary files are removed afterward.

body.zh: 需要 Python 3.12+。安装依赖可能联网，下面的树操作与检查不调用模型。
body.en: Requires Python 3.12+. Dependency installation may need network access; the tree operations and checks below do not call a model.

steps.code:
git clone https://github.com/SuperMarioYL/branchtree.git
cd branchtree
python3 -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
python -m pip install -e .

limitations.zh: 只实现本地树操作和有限规则检查，模型重写尚未实现。
limitations.en: Only local tree operations and limited rule checks are implemented; model regeneration is not.

limitations.zh: 检查结果不是叙事一致性保证，合并不会自动执行检查或阻断矛盾。
limitations.en: Checks do not guarantee narrative consistency; merging does not automatically check or block contradictions.
